name: ASR 声纹录入入口
description: 验证 ASR 页面展示声纹录入入口，并能打开实时朗读录入弹窗

steps.message: ==== 步骤 1: 进入 ASR 页面 ====
声纹录入按钮在已初始化 profile 下可点击
实时朗读声纹录入弹窗可填写用户名称

steps.code: Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'mediaDevices', { configurable: true, value: { getUserMedia: async () => ({ getTracks: () => [{ stop() {} }] }) } }); class MockAudioContext { constructor(){ this.sampleRate = 16000; this.destination = {}; } createMediaStreamSource(){ return { connect(){}, disconnect(){} }; } createScriptProcessor(){ const processor = { onaudioprocess: null, connect(){ const emit = () => processor.onaudioprocess && processor.onaudioprocess({ inputBuffer: { getChannelData: () => new Float32Array(4096).fill(0.2) } }); for (let i = 0; i < 120; i += 1) window.setTimeout(emit, i * 50); }, disconnect(){} }; return processor; } close(){ return Promise.resolve(); } } window.AudioContext = MockAudioContext; window.webkitAudioContext = MockAudioContext; true

steps.message: 声纹录入会提取朗读文本并据此自动推进
